mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message_conversation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_type = 'STAFF_DIRECT' AND staff_pair_key = #{staffPairKey} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'ASSIGNED', 'ACTIVE') AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: c.id, c.conversation_type, c.queue_code, c.customer_id, c.assigned_staff_id, c.status, c.last_seq, p.last_read_seq, GREATEST(c.last_seq - p.last_read_seq, 0) AS unread_count, c.last_message_summary, c.last_message_time, c.closed_time, c.reopen_deadline, c.context_payload
mapper.update: UPDATE message_conversation SET assigned_staff_id = #{staffId}, status = 'ASSIGNED', update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND assigned_staff_id IS NULL AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message_conversation WHERE conversation_type = 'CUSTOMER_SERVICE' AND status IN ('WAITING', 'ASSIGNED', 'ACTIVE') AND COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) < #{inactiveBefore} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
